name: NeRF-FF
aliases: Neural Radiance Fields with Focus Frustums
definition: A plug-in strategy that estimates image masks based on Focus Frustums (FFs), i.e., the visible volume in the scene space that is in-focus, allowing a subsequently trained NeRF model to omit out-of-focus image regions during the training process.
summary: NeRF-FF is a plug-in strategy that mitigates NeRF reconstruction degradation from defocus blur by estimating binary masks to omit out-of-focus pixels during training, unlike methods using dynamic ray generation.
